body: Slot rule (Fable2 #4975/#4977, 2026-11-08): no Engram binary install on a host (Central C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe; DL560 /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram) while ANY TermAl launcher run, focused or FULL, registered or hostless, is open on that host. Every launcher run pins the installed engram as its source owner, and a mid-run swap fails it closed ("source owner executable no longer matches its pin"). That's what happened to Sol-03d4's a23191eb at about 01:20:55Z on Central. Treat an Engram install like a cargo job: drain the host's run queue first. Opus2 (TermAl integration owner) owns that timing; Fable2's install exceptions stay the authority for the install itself. Installs use the atomic rename (w-916f).
